note: Evaluation corpus manifest. All inputs are synthetic and invented; expected outputs state meaning and constraints, never an exact script. Held-out fixtures are never given to generators as examples; heldout_marker strings let eval.mjs corpus check scan the agent briefs, references and library for leakage.
